tools.name: open_bafan
tools.description: Return a link to a Bafan web page: the shop, the user's orders, profile, subscriptions or the mobile app download page. Changes nothing.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the public Bafan storefront for purchasable product variants. A result marked match=partial only matches some search terms.

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.description: List recent Bafan orders. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: list_my_walks
tools.description: List saved Bafan walks, optionally filtered by dog with the dog activity permission. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: list_my_dogs
tools.description: List dogs on your Bafan account, with their basic profile information. Requires dog activity permission.

tools.name: get_dog_activity
tools.description: Get a dog's activity over the last seven days, daily goals, streaks, and totals. Requires dog activity permission.

tools.name: get_payment_recovery_link
tools.description: Get a link to change payment on an eligible order. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Replace the cart contents with the confirmed items. Without a guest cart key it creates a separate guest cart. Signed-in users have one account cart. Returns the items, subtotal and, for guests, a private cart key.

tools.name: set_cart_quantity
tools.description: Set the quantity of one confirmed variant in the cart. Zero removes it. Returns the changed items and subtotal.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read the cart items and subtotal. For a signed-in user, a previous guest cart key merges that guest cart into the account cart.

tools.name: get_order_defaults
tools.description: Get the saved address, delivery and payment defaults of a connected account, or the checkout state of a guest cart.

tools.name: checkout_cart
tools.description: Build the checkout quote from an entered address or a saved address_id, and the chosen delivery, pickup point and payment. Returns the available options, fees, total and quote_complete.

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Prepare an order for online payment. Returns the summary, payment status, next_step and a checkout_url where the shopper reviews and pays on bafan.sk.

tools.name: prepare_cod_order
tools.description: Prepare a cash-on-delivery or pay-at-pickup order without placing it. Returns the summary, terms link, confirmation question and a confirmation token valid for about ten minutes.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place a prepared cash-on-delivery or pay-at-pickup order with a payment obligation. Needs the confirmation token of the prepared order and accept_terms=true, both only after the shopper accepts the terms and confirms. Returns the order number.

tools.name: save_dog_profile
tools.description: Create a dog profile, or update it by supplying dog_id. Confirm the profile changes with the user.

tools.name: delete_dog_profile
tools.description: Permanently delete a dog profile owned by the user. Ask the user to confirm the specific dog and deletion first.

tools.name: list_dog_activities
tools.description: List training, sniffing, play and care activities recorded by the account, optionally for one dog.

tools.name: save_dog_activity
tools.description: Record training, sniffing, play or care, or edit a previous entry by ID. Use occurred_at in UTC. Confirm the dog and details first.

tools.name: delete_dog_activity
tools.description: Delete an activity the user recorded. Set confirm=true only after their explicit confirmation.

tools.name: set_dog_activity_goals
tools.description: Update the dog's daily goals. Use zero to reset a goal to its recommendation.

tools.name: set_dog_light_day
tools.description: Mark a date as a lighter activity day, or remove the mark with enabled=false.

tools.name: list_dog_calendar
tools.description: List upcoming events, reminders and recent veterinary history (vaccinations, deworming, vet visits) for one or all of the user's dogs. Pet records only.

tools.name: list_personal_calendar
tools.description: List the user's calendar entries that are not assigned to a dog.

tools.name: save_personal_calendar_event
tools.description: Create or edit a personal calendar entry. Enter scheduled_for in local time without an offset.

tools.name: complete_personal_calendar_event
tools.description: Mark a personal event done, supplying the exact occurrence for a recurring event.

tools.name: delete_personal_calendar_event
tools.description: Delete a personal calendar event after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: get_dog_health
tools.description: Read a dog's veterinary record kept by its owner: allergies, diet restrictions, medication, the vet clinic contact and microchip number. Pet records only, no human health data.

tools.name: update_dog_health
tools.description: Update a dog's veterinary record or vet clinic contact. Pet records only. An empty string clears that field. Confirm changes and only record information supplied by the user.

tools.name: save_dog_calendar_event
tools.description: Add a dog calendar event or reminder, or edit it by event_id. Enter scheduled_for in the user's local time without an offset.

tools.name: complete_dog_calendar_event
tools.description: Mark a dog calendar event as done. For recurring events use the exact scheduled_for value from the list as occurrence.

tools.name: delete_dog_calendar_event
tools.description: Delete the calendar event and its recurrence, if any. Set confirm=true only after the user explicitly confirms.

tools.name: update_saved_walk
tools.description: Rename or retag a saved walk owned by the user. Confirm the change first.

tools.name: delete_saved_walk
tools.description: Delete a saved walk owned by the user. Set confirm=true only after their explicit confirmation.

tools.name: get_walk_route
tools.description: Get a saved walk's summary and GPS points for a map. When the owner hides the start and end, they are trimmed for everyone except the owner. Use next_offset for more points. Show raw coordinates only when the user explicitly asks for coordinates.

tools.name: list_shared_walks
tools.description: List saved walks that other people shared with the user. Requires walk sharing permission.

tools.name: get_walk_sharing
tools.description: Show an owned walk's visibility, link status and viewers.

tools.name: set_walk_sharing
tools.description: Change a walk's public visibility, whether its exact start and end are hidden, sharing with dog members or comments. Hiding trims the start and end for everyone except the owner in assistant replies, while the Bafan app still shows the full route to people the walk is shared with. Confirm which audi

tools.name: create_walk_share_link
tools.description: Create or show the link to an owned walk after the user explicitly confirms. Anyone who accepts the link can view the walk until the user removes them individually; revoking the link only stops new people from accepting it. Give the user the link without sending it elsewhere.

tools.name: revoke_walk_share
tools.description: Revoke a walk's active link, or remove one granted viewer by member_id. Revoking only the link leaves existing viewer access intact. Confirm the specific change with the user.

tools.name: preview_walk_share
tools.description: Show which walk a Bafan sharing link opens before the user accepts it.

tools.name: accept_walk_share
tools.description: Accept a Bafan walk share link supplied by the user. Show the preview and ask for confirmation first.

tools.name: leave_walk_share
tools.description: Remove the user's own share-link access to a walk. Access through the dog's membership is separate. Ask for confirmation first.

tools.name: list_dog_members
tools.description: List members and roles for a dog the user can view.

tools.name: create_dog_share_link
tools.description: Create a one-use invitation to a dog's profile for a family member, caregiver, or viewer. Show the role and ask for confirmation before creating it. Give the user the link without sending it elsewhere.

tools.name: set_dog_member_access
tools.description: Change or remove a member's access to a dog. Confirm the member and exact change first.

tools.name: transfer_dog_ownership
tools.description: Transfer dog ownership to an existing active member. Only the current owner can transfer. Ask the user to explicitly confirm the dog and new owner first.

tools.name: preview_dog_share
tools.description: Show the dog and role in an invitation before the user accepts it.

tools.name: accept_dog_share
tools.description: Accept a Bafan dog invitation supplied by the user. Show the preview and ask for confirmation first.

tools.name: leave_dog_share
tools.description: Leave a dog profile shared with the user. Confirm which dog first.

tools.name: list_challenges
tools.description: List available Bafan challenges and your participation.

tools.name: get_challenge
tools.description: Show a challenge's rules, progress and leaderboard.

tools.name: join_challenge
tools.description: Join a Bafan challenge after the user confirms. Select the dog when required.

tools.name: claim_challenge_reward
tools.description: Claim an unlocked challenge reward after confirmation.

tools.name: list_dog_awards
tools.description: List a dog's award levels and progress, or look up one award by code.

tools.name: get_bafpoints
tools.description: Read Bafpoints balance and transaction history.

tools.name: list_reservation_offers
tools.description: List bookable Bafan offers and their upcoming dates. Use event_id for availability and required questions.

tools.name: list_my_reservations
tools.description: List the account's upcoming and recent reservations.

tools.name: book_reservation
tools.description: Book an offered date after the user confirms the date, terms and answers.

tools.name: cancel_reservation
tools.description: Cancel an owned reservation after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: Find Bafan recipes by name or ingredient, or list your own or saved recipes.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Read a recipe's ingredients and instructions.

tools.name: save_recipe
tools.description: Create or update a recipe. Save privately unless the user explicitly confirms publication.

tools.name: set_recipe_favorite
tools.description: Save or unsave a recipe for the user.

tools.name: delete_recipe
tools.description: Delete the user's own recipe after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: Read Bafan notifications. Use next_before to continue.

tools.name: mark_notification_read
tools.description: Mark a Bafan notification as read.

tools.name: get_notification_preferences
tools.description: Read Bafan notification preferences.

tools.name: update_notification_preferences
tools.description: Change Bafan notification preferences the user specifies.

tools.name: set_notification_thread_muted
tools.description: Mute or unmute an owned comment thread.

tools.name: list_walk_groups
tools.description: List your walk groups or the saved walks in one group.

tools.name: rename_walk_group
tools.description: Rename one of your walk groups.

tools.name: get_saved_walk_details
tools.description: Show a saved walk's tags, stats, rating and photos. Exact tag coordinates require GPS route permission.

tools.name: save_walk_tag
tools.description: Add or rename a saved walk's tag. When adding, use the coordinates the user provided or chose.

tools.name: delete_walk_tag
tools.description: Remove a saved walk tag after the user confirms.

tools.name: get_walk_photo_upload_link
tools.description: Return a Bafan page to upload photos directly to the user's saved walk. Use the link for real photos from the user's device.

tools.name: delete_walk_photo
tools.description: Delete a photo from an owned walk after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: rate_walk
tools.description: Submit the user's own walk rating after confirmation.

tools.name: set_walk_favorite
tools.description: Save or unsave a walk as a favorite.

tools.name: list_walk_comments
tools.description: Read comments on a saved walk the user can see.

tools.name: post_walk_comment
tools.description: Post the exact comment the user approved. Use parent_id to reply.

tools.name: search_nearby
tools.description: Search Bafan places, public walks and events, optionally around a supplied location.

tools.name: generate_walk_route
tools.description: Suggest walking loops from coordinates the user chose. Allowed distances are 3000, 5000, 8000 and 10000 metres.

tools.name: list_route_plans
tools.description: List the user's saved route plans without their route geometry.

tools.name: get_route_plan
tools.description: Read one of the user's saved route plans.

tools.name: save_route_plan
tools.description: Save a suggested walking loop for later, with its start and route. Reuse request_id when retrying.

tools.name: rename_route_plan
tools.description: Rename one of the user's saved plans.

tools.name: delete_route_plan
tools.description: Delete one of the user's route plans after explicit confirmation.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "list_dog_awards" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_bafan, list_notifications, mark_notification_read, get_notification_preferences, list_walk_comments · Private data: create_cart, prepare_cod_order, place_order, save_dog_activity, list_dog_calendar, get_dog_health, update_dog_health · Public sink: create_walk_share_link, revoke_walk_share, preview_walk_share, accept_walk_share, leave_walk_share, create_dog_share_link, preview_dog_share, accept_dog_share, leave_dog_share, get_walk_photo_upload_link, rate_walk, post_walk_comment · Destructive: delete_dog_profile, delete_dog_activity, set_dog_activity_goals, set_dog_light_day, delete_personal_calendar_event, delete_dog_calendar_event, delete_saved_walk, revoke_walk_share, leave_walk_share, set_dog_member_access, delete_recipe, delete_walk_tag, delete_walk_photo, delete_route_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_bafan, list_notifications, mark_notification_read, get_notification_preferences, list_walk_comments · Private data: create_cart, prepare_cod_order, place_order, save_dog_activity, list_dog_calendar, get_dog_health, update_dog_health · Public sink: create_walk_share_link, revoke_walk_share, preview_walk_share, accept_walk_share, leave_walk_share, create_dog_share_link, preview_dog_share, accept_dog_share, leave_dog_share, get_walk_photo_upload_link, rate_walk, post_walk_comment · Destructive: delete_dog_profile, delete_dog_activity, set_dog_activity_goals, set_dog_light_day, delete_personal_calendar_event, delete_dog_calendar_event, delete_saved_walk, revoke_walk_share, leave_walk_share, set_dog_member_access, delete_recipe, delete_walk_tag, delete_walk_photo, delete_route_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
